versions.content: If If development error detection for the module Fls is enabled: the function Fls_Compare shall check that the given length is greater than 0 and that the compare end address (compare start address + length) lies within the specified upper flash address boundary. If this check fails, the function Fls_Compare shall reject the compare job, raise the development error FLS_E_PARAM_LENGTH and return with E_ NOT_OK.
